exclusions.round_1_historical_episodes: All accepted real Episode manifests are May-July 2024 Round 1 identities and are excluded.
exclusions.synthetic_prospective_fixtures: PSS dry-run records such as EP_EVENT_PROSPECTIVE use placeholder 2030 timestamps and are explicitly non-authoritative test fixtures; they cannot populate a live Slice.

selection_rule: Select unique future Episodes in authoritative release order, then exact release timestamp and Episode identity, excluding all Round 1 identities and any unresolved or reused identity.
source_authority_finding: No authoritative current prospective Episode registry, release schedule, or future event source is present in repository evidence.
